具有高级双引导和 CFGOverride 的 Ideogram 4 优化工作流程

Experimental_dAIver 的另一个新的、改进的和增强的工作流程。

该工作流程带来了令人印象深刻的图像质量、迅速的一致性和电影般的优势表意文字4直接进入您本地的 ComfyUI 设置。它具有主模型和无条件模型的专用加载、复杂的 DualModelGuider、专门的 Ideogram4Scheduler、通过 Qwen3-VL 的高质量文本编码、Flux VAE 解码和完整的集成 SeedVR2 Video Upscaler 管道。

这个版本的最大亮点就是CFG覆盖节点，它优雅地利用了 Ideogram 4 的不对称无分类器指导：在自然构图的早期步骤中进行温和、有机的指导，然后在最后阶段有针对性地提高 CFG，以实现卓越的细节、清晰度和即时保真度。

v1.5 的主要功能：

  • 对 Ideogram 4 fp8_scaled 及其使用 DualModelGuider + ConditioningZeroOut 的无条件变体的完全本机支持

  • CFG覆盖节点– 在前 70-85% 的步骤中进行温和引导 (CFG ~1) 以实现自然结构，然后在最后阶段提高 CFG (3-7) 以实现精确的细节细化

  • 自定义 Ideogram4Scheduler，具有质量预设（Turbo/默认/质量）和通过 JSON 驱动的 MATH 子图进行动态 mu/std 控制

  • 由 Qwen3-VL 8B fp8_scaled 提供强大的文本理解能力（可选 Gemma4 支持）

  • 通过 Flux VAE 进行高质量解码

  • 具有自动 16 倍数计算和动态宽度/高度路由功能的分辨率选择器

  • 模块化架构，具有全功能 SeedVR2 Video Upscaler 子图，可实现出色的 4K+ 静态图像和短视频序列

  • 智能 VRAM 优化助手（easy cleanGpuUsed）和卸载选项

  • 包括丰富、高度详细的结构化 JSON 示例提示，展示具有精确材质渲染和戏剧性灯光的概念食品摄影

所需的自定义节点

  • ComfyUI-易于使用– 提供easy cleanGpuUsed、easy float、easy Compare等辅助节点。通过 ComfyUI 管理器安装。

  • ComfyUI-KJNodes– 升频器部分中的 LazySwitchKJ 节点是必需的。

  • ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler – https://github.com/ainvfx/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler– 支持高质量的升级和视频功能。

重要：首先将您的 ComfyUI 更新到最新版本，至少 v0.24。 Ideogram 4 支持、Ideogram4Scheduler、DualModelGuider 和 CFGOverride 是最近核心更新的一部分。

模型和下载（确切路径）

以下列表解释了我在此工作流程中最常使用的基本模型。该列表还解释了下载每个文件后将其放置在哪里。

1.VAE：

  • 文件：Flux2-vae.safetensors

  • 下载： https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/resolve/main/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors

  • 目标文件夹：ComfyUI/模型/vae/

2. 主要扩散模型（表意文字 4 fp8 缩放）：

  • 文件：ideogram4_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • 下载： https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ideogram4_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • 目标文件夹：ComfyUI/模型/diffusion_models/

3.无条件扩散模型（表意文字4）：

  • 文件：ideogram4_unconditional_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • 下载： https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ideogram4_unconditional_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • 目标文件夹：ComfyUI/模型/diffusion_models/

4. 文本编码器（Qwen3-VL 8B）：

  • 文件：qwen3vl_8b_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • 下载： https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3-VL/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • 目标文件夹：ComfyUI/模型/text_encoders/

5. 文本编码器（Gemma4 E4B IT – 可选）：

  • 文件：gemma4_e4b_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • 下载： https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/gemma-4/resolve/main/text_encoders/gemma4_e4b_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • 目标文件夹：ComfyUI/模型/text_encoders/

模型存储位置

📂 舒适UI/
├── 📂 模特/
│ ├── 📂腿/
│ │ └── Flux2-vae.safetensors
│ ├── 📂 扩散_模型/
│ │ ├── ideogram4_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│ │ └── ideogram4_unconditional_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│ └── 📂 文本编码器/
│ ├── qwen3vl_8b_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│ └── gemma4_e4b_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors

推荐设置

采样器：欧拉（或欧拉祖先/res_multistep）

步骤：Turbo (12)、Default (20) 或 Quality (48) – 可通过质量选择器进行选择

基本分辨率：可通过ResolutionSelector自由选择（自动调整为16的倍数）

CFG 比例（DualModelGuider）：1.0（基础）

CFG覆盖：从 CFG 1 开始，从约 70-85 % 的步数提高到 3-7（start_percent 0.7-0.9）Ideogram4Scheduler mu / std：由质量预设自动设置（Turbo：mu 0.5 / std 1.75，默认：mu 0.0 / std 1.75，Quality：mu 0.0 / std 1.5）

如何使用工作流程

  1. 将 ComfyUI 更新到包含 Ideogram 4 支持的最新版本。

  2. 通过 ComfyUI Manager 或克隆存储库来安装上面列出的所需自定义节点。

  3. 下载所有模型并将它们准确地放置在上面指定的文件夹中。

  4. 将 JSON 工作流程文件加载到 ComfyUI 中。

  5. 提示：大型“CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)”节点接受结构化 JSON 提示（模型是根据这种格式进行训练的）。该工作流程包括详细的内部指南，解释了创建提示的三种方法：

    • 原始自然语言或结构化 JSON（推荐用于最大程度的控制）

    • 通过集成的 Gemma 4 Prompt Builder 子图进行 LLM 辅助提示

    • 直接编辑 high_level_description、style_description（具有美学、照明、color_palette）和compositional_deconstruction（具有标准化边界框和每个对象的调色板）

    随附的示例提示（带有地球、木星和天王星勺的蛋卷冰淇淋的超现实概念食品摄影）展示了该模型在精确材质渲染、戏剧性电影照明和创意概念扭曲方面的出色能力。

  6. 质量和分辨率：使用质量选择器（Turbo / 默认 / 质量）自动设置步骤、mu 和 std。使用分辨率选择器选择宽高比和百万像素 - 宽度和高度会自动计算并正确布线。

  7. CFGOverride（秘密武器）：该节点在早期步骤中保持温和的引导（自然构图和比例），并在最后阶段提高 CFG，以获得锐利的细节、纹理和迅速的附着力。该技术对于 Ideogram 4 的非对称引导特别有效。

  8. 对提示进行排队。上半部分使用强大的双引导+CFGOverride系统生成基础图像。

  9. 可选的高质量升级：较低的 SeedVR2 部分可以输入生成的图像，以生成令人惊叹的高分辨率静态图像或短视频序列。

  10. 查看 PreviewImage 节点中的结果并使用扩展的 SaveImageExtended 节点保存（包括完整元数据）。

这是 Ideogram 4 的干净、强大且面向未来的基础工作流程。如果您只需要基础生成，则可以完全绕过或静音升级组。即使在中档硬件上也能轻松运行。

我使用 CFGOverride 技术和动态质量预设进一步完善了这个版本。温和的早期指导和有针对性的后期细化相结合，再加上结构化的 JSON 提示方法，确实让 Ideogram 4 脱颖而出——尤其是在概念性、氛围性和高度详细的场景中。

非常感谢 Comfy-Org 出色的 Ideogram 4 实现，以及 realrebelai 为我构建和优化的原始基本工作流程。

如果您有疑问、反馈或想分享您的结果 – 我总是很高兴在评论中收到您的来信。享受工作流程并快乐创作！

o.en:
Optimized Workflow for Ideogram 4 with Advanced Dual Guidance & CFGOverride

Another new, refined and enhanced workflow by Experimental_dAIver.

This workflow brings the impressive image quality, prompt adherence and cinematic strengths ofIdeogram 4directly into your local ComfyUI setup. It features dedicated loading of both the main and unconditional models, a sophisticated DualModelGuider, the specialized Ideogram4Scheduler, high-quality text encoding via Qwen3-VL, Flux VAE decoding and a complete integrated SeedVR2 Video Upscaler pipeline.

The highlight of this version is theCFGOverridenode, which elegantly exploits Ideogram 4’s asymmetric classifier-free guidance: gentle, organic guidance in the early steps for natural composition, followed by a targeted raise in CFG during the final phase for exceptional detail, sharpness and prompt fidelity.

Key features in v1.5:

  • Full native support for Ideogram 4 fp8_scaled together with its unconditional variant using DualModelGuider + ConditioningZeroOut

  • CFGOverride node– gentle guidance (CFG ~1) in the first 70–85 % of steps for natural structure, then raised CFG (3–7) in the final phase for precise detail refinement

  • Custom Ideogram4Scheduler with quality presets (Turbo / Default / Quality) and dynamic mu/std control via JSON-driven MATH subgraphs

  • Powerful text understanding powered by Qwen3-VL 8B fp8_scaled (with optional Gemma4 support)

  • High-quality decoding via Flux VAE

  • ResolutionSelector with automatic multiple-of-16 calculation and dynamic width/height routing

  • Modular architecture with a full-featured SeedVR2 Video Upscaler subgraph for exceptional 4K+ stills and short video sequences

  • Smart VRAM optimization helpers (easy cleanGpuUsed) and offload options

  • Includes a rich, highly detailed structured JSON example prompt demonstrating conceptual food photography with precise material rendering and dramatic lighting

Required Custom Nodes

  • ComfyUI-easy-use– Provides easy cleanGpuUsed, easy float, easy compare and other helper nodes. Install via ComfyUI Manager.

  • ComfyUI-KJNodes– Required for the LazySwitchKJ node in the upscaler section.

  • ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler – https://github.com/ainvfx/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler– Powers the high-quality upscaling and video features.

Important:Update your ComfyUI to the latest version first, at least v0.24. Ideogram 4 support, Ideogram4Scheduler, DualModelGuider and CFGOverride are part of recent core updates.

Models & Downloads (exact paths)

The following list explains the base models I am most frequently using with this workflow. The list as well explains where to put each file after you downloaded it.

1. VAE:

  • File:flux2-vae.safetensors

  • Download: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/resolve/main/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors

  • Target folder:ComfyUI/models/vae/

2. Main Diffusion Model (Ideogram 4 fp8 scaled):

  • File:ideogram4_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • Download: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ideogram4_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • Target folder:ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/

3. Unconditional Diffusion Model (Ideogram 4):

  • File:ideogram4_unconditional_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • Download: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ideogram4_unconditional_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • Target folder:ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/

4. Text Encoder (Qwen3-VL 8B):

  • File:qwen3vl_8b_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • Download: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3-VL/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • Target folder:ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/

5. Text Encoder (Gemma4 E4B IT – optional):

  • File:gemma4_e4b_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • Download: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/gemma-4/resolve/main/text_encoders/gemma4_e4b_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors

  • Target folder:ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/

Model Storage Location

📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│ ├── 📂 vae/
│ │ └── flux2-vae.safetensors
│ ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│ │ ├── ideogram4_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│ │ └── ideogram4_unconditional_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│ └── 📂 text_encoders/
│ ├── qwen3vl_8b_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│ └── gemma4_e4b_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors

Recommended Settings

Sampler:Euler (or Euler ancestral / res_multistep)

Steps:Turbo (12), Default (20) or Quality (48) – selectable via the Quality Selector

Base Resolution:Freely selectable via ResolutionSelector (automatically adjusted to multiple of 16)

CFG Scale (DualModelGuider):1.0 (base)

CFGOverride:Start at CFG 1, raise to 3–7 from ~70–85 % of steps onward (start_percent 0.7–0.9)Ideogram4Scheduler mu / std:Automatically set by the quality preset (Turbo: mu 0.5 / std 1.75, Default: mu 0.0 / std 1.75, Quality: mu 0.0 / std 1.5)

How to use the workflow

  1. Update ComfyUI to the latest version that includes Ideogram 4 support.

  2. Install the required custom nodes listed above via ComfyUI Manager or by cloning the repositories.

  3. Download all models and place them exactly in the folders specified above.

  4. Load the JSON workflow file into ComfyUI.

  5. Prompting:The large “CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)” node accepts structured JSON prompts (the model was trained on this format). The workflow includes a detailed internal guide explaining three ways to create prompts:

    • Raw natural language or structured JSON (recommended for maximum control)

    • LLM-assisted prompting via the integrated Gemma 4 Prompt Builder subgraph

    • Direct editing of the high_level_description, style_description (with aesthetics, lighting, color_palette) and compositional_deconstruction (with normalized bounding boxes and per-object color palettes)

    The included example prompt (hyper-realistic conceptual food photography of an ice cream cone with Earth, Jupiter and Uranus scoops) demonstrates the model’s excellent capabilities in precise material rendering, dramatic cinematic lighting and creative conceptual twists.

  6. Quality & Resolution:Use theQuality Selector(Turbo / Default / Quality) to automatically set steps, mu and std. Use theResolutionSelectorto choose aspect ratio and megapixels – width and height are automatically calculated and routed correctly.

  7. CFGOverride (the secret weapon):The node keeps guidance gentle in the early steps (natural composition and proportions) and raises CFG in the final phase for razor-sharp detail, texture and prompt adherence. This technique is particularly effective with Ideogram 4’s asymmetric guidance.

  8. Queue the prompt. The upper section generates the base image using the powerful dual guidance + CFGOverride system.

  9. Optional high-quality upscaling:The lower SeedVR2 section can be fed with the generated image to produce stunning high-resolution stills or short video sequences.

  10. Review results in the PreviewImage node and save with the extended SaveImageExtended node (includes full metadata).

This is a clean, powerful and future-proof base workflow for Ideogram 4. You can bypass or mute the upscaler group entirely if you only need the base generation. It runs comfortably even on mid-range hardware.

I’ve refined this version further with the CFGOverride technique and dynamic quality presets. The combination of gentle early guidance and targeted late-stage refinement, together with the structured JSON prompting approach, really lets Ideogram 4 shine — especially in conceptual, atmospheric and highly detailed scenes.

Huge thanks to Comfy-Org for the excellent Ideogram 4 implementation and to realrebelai for the original base workflow that I built upon and optimized.

If you have questions, feedback or want to share your results – I’m always happy to hear from you in the comments. Enjoy the workflow and happy creating!
